Hi — could you please draft a warm, professional confirmation email I can send to a client who just booked a 90-minute Thai yoga massage at the retreat next week? Use my name and the contact email you have on file in the signature, and keep the tone calm, grounding, and slightly formal. Include:

- Appointment date and time (placeholder fields I can fill in)
- Location details (retreat treatment room + brief directions)
- What to wear and what to expect during a Thai yoga massage
- A short pre-session intake checklist (health questions, recent injuries, pregnancy note)
- Cancellation and rescheduling policy (48-hour notice, fee for late cancellations)
- Payment instructions (I accept card on-site and EFT; request payment method)
- A gentle reminder to arrive 10–15 minutes early and to bring any medical notes
- A note about COVID/illness policy (please reschedule if unwell)
- A signature block with my name, qualification (Diploma in Holistic Health and Therapeutic Massage), role at the boutique retreat, and the contact email you already have on file

Also please provide a concise SMS reminder (1–2 lines) to send 24 hours before the appointment and a short calendar invite description I can paste into a meeting invite. Keep all language clear and client-friendly, reflecting my empathetic, grounded style.
